product_overview: GROCEESARY is a hyperlocal, multi-vendor grocery marketplace web application built with a file-per-page PHP architecture for rapid development and zero-code deployment across XAMPP and cPanel. It connects customers with nearby vendors, providing core ecommerce flows including registration, authentication, product browsing, multi-vendor carting and order management.
core_goals: Enable a multi-vendor hyperlocal grocery marketplace that connects customers with nearby vendors quickly and reliably.
Provide a simplified, file-per-page PHP architecture for rapid development, easy debugging, and zero-code deployment to XAMPP and cPanel.
Deliver core commerce functionality (registration, authentication, product browsing, cart and order flows) with strong security and mobile-first UX.
Support vendor onboarding and basic admin controls to manage vendors, products, and payouts while ensuring data privacy and compliance.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow registered users (customers/vendors) to authenticate using email and password and access their home/dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /pages/auth/login.php -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See customer home at /pages/customer/home.php
Navigate to /pages/auth/login.php -> Fill in email -> Fill in incorrect password -> Submit login form -> See authentication failure notification

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Allow new users to create an account with email and password and complete optional OTP verification to activate their account.
user_flows: Navigate to /pages/auth/register.php -> Provide name, email, and password -> Submit registration form -> Receive OTP challenge -> Provide correct OTP -> See registration success and prompt to login at /pages/auth/login.php
Navigate to /pages/auth/register.php -> Provide invalid email or mismatched passwords -> Submit registration form -> See validation error indicating required corrections
Navigate to /pages/auth/register.php -> Provide name, email, and password -> Submit registration form -> Receive OTP challenge -> Provide incorrect OTP -> See OTP verification failure

features.name: Customer Home (Browse)
features.description: Provide a public customer home page that surfaces featured products and allows customers to browse, search, filter and add items to the cart.
user_flows: Navigate to /pages/customer/home.php -> Browse featured products -> Use search or filters to refine results -> Add an item to cart -> See cart updated with selected item
Navigate to /pages/customer/home.php -> Search for an unavailable item -> See no results found indication
